description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing notes within a note-taking application. It includes state management, data persistence, and utility functions for CRUD operations on notes.

methods.name: useNotes
methods.description: Custom React hook to access the NotesContext value, throws an error if used outside provider.

methods.name: NotesProvider
methods.description: React functional component that supplies the notes context to children, manages notes state, persistence, and toast notifications.
